howToPlay: Use the Super to pass through walls and approach enemies while remaining untouchable. Position yourself to hit targets with the center of the main attack for maximum damage and a movement speed boost. Use gadgets to extend your reach or escape danger by fearing opponents.
gears: Equip SPEED to capitalize on mobility, SHIELD to compensate for lower health, or GADGET COOLDOWN to utilize special abilities more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical flanking and using terrain to outmaneuver opponents.
